sample_unit: patients with CVD and depression who sent at least one portal message between diagnoses
unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to screen longitudinal patient portal messages as an early warning system for depression diagnosis in patients with cardiovascular disease

screen.reason: The study evaluates the retrospective accuracy and simulated lead-time benefit of applying open-weights LLMs to patient portal messages to screen for depression, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or operational practice.
